refreshCommand:
python3 - "$SDK_TARBALL" "$SDK_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST" Tests/B4AdapterTests/Fixtures/agent-protocol <<'B4APP_REFRESH'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, sys, tarfile
package, provenance, destination = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
expected_package = "c01d03b78c91e29ace2ae0af0fe5eaf974b318e4e512c3b5fda188ca53ca44ce"
expected_manifest = "3c2ce413edee75ff1da59d79fa3d592e3ea32ba2e78bd2ac9aee4f55dd35dcb2"
assert hashlib.sha256(package.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected_package
assert hashlib.sha256(provenance.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected_manifest
record = json.loads(provenance.read_bytes())
assert record["tarballSha256"] == expected_package
entries = {entry["path"]: entry for entry in record["files"]}
expected_files = {
    "agent-protocol.schema.json": "bcea770e7338cf3dbc3c47c5fa2078e802d3042d82e6173225ad6cbb6230c5fb",
    "agent-protocol.fixtures.json": "37fb22423bcfd5eeee951f99f5365f4374d8ae85cc25950f8f308a70c3647248",
}
destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with tarfile.open(package, "r:gz") as archive:
    for name, expected in expected_files.items():
        member = "package/dist/" + name
        content = archive.extractfile(member).read()
        assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == entries[member]["sha256"] == expected
        assert len(content) == entries[member]["bytes"]
        (destination / name).write_bytes(content)
B4APP_REFRESH

refreshEnvironment.SDK_TARBALL: Path to the exact package tarball identified by package.sha256
refreshEnvironment.SDK_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST: Path to the exact pack artifact manifest identified by artifactManifest.sha256
